title: Require Service Model Kind Indices
forbids: a model-kind index with logic, imports, star exports, parent or cross-kind forwarding, or a model leaf importing its own index
why: A curated kind-local index shortens downstream imports without flattening service ownership or creating self-import cycles. The model owner and kind remain visible in every access path.
remediate: Keep index.ts to explicit named re-exports from direct sibling leaf files. Use direct files within the same model owner and the kind index from contracts, modules, and routers. Never add a whole-model, module-root, package-public, or star-export barrel.
message: Service model kind indices must remain curated index modules.
